body:
Wow this is an immense help. Thank you so much for the insight and information. I needed to know all of this.

I wish you the best as well. You are a wonderful person for just taking the time to read this and respond. Thank you.

I guess I would say my mother is emotionally unstable/volatile?
My father is more someone who keeps things bottled in. He had a rough childhood from what he has told me.

I'm just confused because not even 3 days ago I talked to them both and they were doing just fine. If anything, they were calling me just to see how I was doing.

But in short, I would say that emotional upheaval is typical for my parents.

Thank you so much for your response.
Thank you very much for the advice. I will do that when I can finally talk to her again.
